questions.question: Change 5 km to metres and 3 m to centimetres. Explain whether you multiplied or divided.
questions.expected_answer: 5 km is 5 times 1 000, which is 5 000 m. 3 m is 3 times 100, which is 300 cm. I multiplied both times, because I changed to a smaller unit, so the number gets bigger.

questions.question: How many metres are in half a kilometre and in three quarters of a kilometre?
questions.expected_answer: Half of 1 000 m is 500 m. A quarter of 1 000 m is 250 m, so three quarters is 3 times 250, which is 750 m.

questions.question: 6 m of ribbon is cut into pieces 25 cm long. How many pieces are there?
questions.expected_answer: Change to the same unit: 6 m is 600 cm. 600 divided by 25 is 24, so there are 24 pieces.
